claims: Spring break 2026 generally runs from early March through mid-April.
The peak week for colleges is March 14–21, 2026.
Key destinations mentioned in Wikipedia and OnlineSchools.org include Panama City Beach (Florida), South Padre Island (Texas), Daytona Beach (Florida), and Cancun (Mexico).
Spring break began as a swimming team training tradition in the 1930s, as noted in Wikipedia.
Average expenses reach over $1,100 per person in popular areas like Florida and Texas.
